proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: No magic_item kind exists in UnitRecord. types.ts defines only SpellRecord, ClassFeatureRecord, and MasteryRecord. The v4 taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom but there is no authored surface type with kind: "magic_item", no mechanics family, and no tracer branch for magic items.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Feather Token carries kind: magic_item in the survey manifest. The UnitRecord union has no MagicItemRecord arm.

proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_variant_family
proposed_widenings.justification: Feather Token is a family of 6 distinct single-use tokens (Anchor, Bird, Fan, Swan Boat, Tree, Whip), each with mechanically independent effects. No variant-family shape exists in the surface. The surface would need either six separate records or a variant-dispatch envelope with shared metadata and per-variant mechanics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Different types of feather tokens exist, each with a different single-use effect. The GM chooses the kind of token or determines it randomly by rolling on the Feather Tokens table.

proposed_widenings.name: single_use_charge_with_item_destruction
proposed_widenings.justification: Each token is consumed on use and disappears permanently. The existing charge atom covers per-use depletion but there is no lifecycle shape for item-destruction-on-expend (the item ceases to exist, not merely becomes inert). A 'disappear on expend' expiry variant is needed in the surface.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When the effect ends, the token disappears. (Anchor) / The token disappears and an enormous, multicolored bird takes its place. (Bird)

proposed_widenings.name: attack_proxy_with_bonus_action_redirect
proposed_widenings.justification: The Whip token creates a floating weapon proxy (create_attack_proxy atom exists in v4) that can be redirected up to 20 feet as a Bonus Action each turn to repeat its attack. The existing on_hit_trigger and mastery attack_proxy patterns do not cover a persistent, owner-controlled proxy with a per-turn redirect cost. A redirect mechanics shape is missing from the surface.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Bonus Action, you can direct the whip to fly up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 10 feet of the whip.

notes: Encoding is blocked at the top-level kind: MagicItemRecord does not exist in UnitRecord. Even if a magic_item family were added, the Feather Token would require a variant-family envelope (six tokens) before any per-token mechanics could be authored. For reference: Whip is the most encodable variant (create_attack_proxy + action_quota + fixed damage 1d6+5 force, +9 attack); Tree and Anchor are partially expressible (create_object, block_travel); Bird requires create_companion with complex carry and dismiss logic; Fan and Swan Boat operate on vehicles, which are not in the creature/object model. None of the six tokens can be forced into a SpellRecord, ClassFeatureRecord, or MasteryRecord without producing a misleading trace.
